one_line: Jensen Huang resigns from Nvidia amid regulatory and personal scrutiny, while OpenAI and Amazon advance AI shopping agents.

themes.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
themes.text: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned following admissions of personal relationships and federal investigations into chip sales, leaving CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO. The leadership change has triggered congressional inquiries, Wall Street concerns over future dealmaking, and anxiety among start-up investors.

themes.title: AI agents enter the shopping market
themes.text: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet to allow its AI agents to make purchases for users, while Amazon drafted a plan for a World Product Graph to index global product data for search and shopping agents.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI agent shopping
Amazon plans World Product Graph to index global product data for AI agents

themes.title: Nscale faces funding pressure over Anthropic deal
themes.text: Nscale revealed it needs additional financing to meet 2027 obligations following a $45 billion Anthropic chip order, placing its planned IPO in doubt as it reported billions in debt and losses.

stories.headline: Nscale says it needs extra funding for 2027 commitments after $45B Anthropic chip order
Nscale reports $5.5B in debt and $1.69B loss in amended IPO filing
